Our Story

Local Contractors You Can Count On

Titan Consulting Contracting is a registered contractor based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, with hands-on experience across roofing, siding, gutters, windows, and full-home exterior and interior work.

From full roof replacements to winter interior repairs, we bring the same standard to every job: do it right, treat the home with respect, and stand behind the work. We're a local, hands-on team—when you call Titan, you get people who actually show up and care about the result.

We serve homeowners throughout Iowa and Illinois, including the Quad Cities and Waterloo areas.
